strokes.text: Manages one OBS input of any installed kind, the settings you choose to manage, and its first placement in a scene.
Use it for cameras, browser sources, captures, text and any source a plugin adds.
obs-websocket creates a source by placing it in a scene, so the resource also owns that first placement, called the anchor.
The `settings_json` object owns exactly its top-level keys.
A key you leave out keeps its OBS value, and removing a key from the object stops managing it without resetting it.
A nested object is owned as a whole, and a top-level `null` is rejected.
The value is marked sensitive in plan output, but Terraform state still stores it, so keep state private.
Import by collection name, source UUID, anchor scene UUID and anchor scene item ID, separated by pipe characters:
An imported source starts with no managed settings, and the first apply of matching configuration takes ownership of the keys it lists.

glazes.kind: OBS input kind, for example `browser_source` or `color_source_v3`. It must be a kind the running OBS has registered. Changing it replaces the resource.
glazes.name: Name of the source as shown in OBS. Changing it replaces the resource.
